# Citations

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask citations` from docs/research/sources/MANIFEST.toml, the source
citations in the tree's documents and code, and docs/data/citations-code.tsv. Do not edit:
change those and regenerate. `cargo xtask sources` fails when this file is stale. -->

Every protocol claim traces to a primary source recorded in
[MANIFEST.toml](research/sources/MANIFEST.toml) with a SHA-256: committed where a build or test
reads it, otherwise cited by URL and hash. This page lists, by key, each source a document or a
source file cites, each one committed under docs/research/sources/ and each one a code item
rests on: its title, URL and digest, where its copy is, the day it was read where its entry
says, the files that cite it and the code items it supports. A citation of a key resolves to
its entry here, at `docs/citations.md#<key>`.
